# Fachry Nuzuli Kamal: Complete Public Context

Canonical URL: https://fachrynuzuli.com/
Summary Index: https://fachrynuzuli.com/llms.txt

## One-Line Positioning

Product builder teaching non-technical people how to build in this economy

## Identity & Background

- Full name: Fachry Nuzuli Kamal
- Location: Riau, Indonesia
- Current role: Sr Product Manager (Digital Transformation Lead), APRIL Group, Transport Division
- Education: Bachelor of Economics, USU (Universitas Sumatera Utara, graduated 2020)
- Languages: Bahasa Indonesia (native), English (fluent)
- Compass: Make employment optional.

## What He Does (Now)

### 1. Enterprise Product Leadership (APRIL Group, Transport Division, May 2022 onward)
- Owns product direction and approves all change requests for the Fleet Management System (FMS) product suite, integrating Driver Management, Fuel Management, and Workshop Management alongside core dispatch and fleet operations.
- Leads digital transformation initiatives across fleet, tyre, and woodhandling operations.
- Drives organization-wide AI enablement, growing adoption from an initial team of 5 people to up to 900 people across operational shifts.

### 2. Teaching Non-Technical People How to Build in This Economy
Fachry teaches non-technical professionals the practical habits, product thinking, and AI workflows needed to ship real products and build durable leverage:

- **AI-assisted building & product craft**: Shipping real software with Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, and Lovable, backed by 1,000+ hours of hands-on building since late 2024, alongside PRDs, user stories, prioritization, and roadmaps. Created the `lovable-framework` skill to systematize prompt-to-product execution.
- **Philosophy and mindset**: Schools of thought, first-principles reasoning, and durable mental models.
- **Economics, finance, and business literacy**: Enough finance and unit economics to read how money moves through a company, backed by prior buy-side/research experience as a Senior Equity Research Analyst.
- **Influence without authority**: Persuasion, managing up, stakeholder alignment, and leading without formal title. Created the `Sharemaxxing` skill to teach AI how to sharpen the clarity and influence of public writing.
- **The Kamal Way (five-step personal development framework)**:
  1. Know Yourself
  2. Acquire Skill
  3. Make It Your Passion
  4. Adjust Perspective
  5. Lifelong Project

He has trained 200+ non-technical professionals in practical AI workflows.

### 3. Live Publication: In This Economy (https://in.thisecono.my/)
In This Economy is a live static website structured as a book.

Three core theses:
1. **Hard now, asymmetric later**: Short-term macro headwinds are real, yet AI, content, and marketing unlock rare asymmetric upside.
2. **Own a piece of a business**: Own a piece of a business, either by building one yourself or investing in one with discipline.
3. **Earn cash, buy equity**: Concrete frameworks for earning cash flow today while steadily acquiring equity and optionality.

## Chronological Journey (2020 to Now)

### 2020 | Bachelor of Economics (Accounting) | Universitas Sumatera Utara (USU)
- Formal grounding in financial statements, cost accounting, and capital flows that shapes how he scopes software products and measures operational return on investment.

### Apr 2021 to Sep 2021 | Senior Analyst (Mining, Tech, Consumer, FMCG) | INVESTABOOK
- Covered Indonesian public equities across Mining, Technology, Consumer, and FMCG sectors for a financial research startup with an audience of 80,000+ retail investors.
- Contributed to 4x revenue growth reaching approximately US$50K MRR.
- Helped improve 30-day subscriber retention from 15% to 25%.
- Launched two educational cohorts and published an archive of ~17 Indonesian equity research essays grounded in margin of safety, business quality, and capital allocation.

### Sep 2021 to May 2022 | Operations Analyst, Transport Division | APRIL Group
- Built SQL and SAP analytical workflows covering 150+ daily operational transactions.
- Identified operational bottlenecks contributing to a 15% reduction in downtime.

### May 2022 onward | Sr Product Manager (Digital Transformation Lead), Transport Division | APRIL Group
- Progressed from delivering individual digital projects to owning full product direction for the Fleet Management System suite and leading cross-site transformation across fleet, tyre, and woodhandling operations.

## Verified Proof & Impact Numbers

- **Fleet scale**: Fleet Management System covers 400+ vehicles across 3 operational sites.
- **Portfolio value**: Wider digital product portfolio valued at approximately US$1.3M across 9 operational systems.
- **Trip utilization**: 37 minutes of utilization gained per trip (~US$301K annual impact).
- **Asset longevity**: RFID tyre tracking extended tyre asset life by 5% (~US$207K annual savings).
- **Digital adoption**: 1,000+ users transitioned from paper workflows to digital systems (100% migration).
- **AI enablement**: Trained 200+ non-technical professionals; scaled internal AI enablement from 5 team members to up to 900 people across operational shifts.
- **Hands-on AI building**: 1,000+ hours building with AI tools since late 2024.

## Rebuilt System Theses (Portfolio Architecture Without Confidential Detail)

These nine systems represent the operational problem spaces Fachry has owned and shipped in industrial logistics and workforce operations, presented as public product theses without proprietary company internals:

1. **Fleet Management System (FMS)**: End-to-end dispatch orders, truck allocation, dynamic rerouting, and trip-cycle tracking to eliminate idle bottlenecks across multi-site heavy-hauling fleets.
2. **Tyre Management System**: Complete tyre registries, historical wear and retread logs, and RFID identification to turn consumable maintenance into measurable asset-life extension.
3. **Driver Management System**: Structured driver recruitment pipelines, certification tracking, chronological performance histories, and workforce readiness management.
4. **Driver Behavior & Fatigue Control**: Real-time behavioral telemetry and fatigue intervention workflows designed to improve field safety outcomes.
5. **Workshop Management System**: Preventive and corrective repair scheduling, service-bay queue coordination, and turnaround visibility for heavy fleet assets.
6. **Fuel Management System**: Automated fuel dispensing integrated with RFID identification to close reconciliation gaps and prevent leakage.
7. **Futong Loading System**: Port-side cargo loading coordination, queue synchronization, and throughput visibility.
8. **Digital Woodyard System**: Digitized yard receiving, cargo unloading orchestration, and inventory movement tracking.
9. **E-Learning, Face ID Attendance & Control Tower**: Replacing live classroom instruction with scalable digital e-learning, deploying biometric Face ID shift attendance, and unifying field telemetry into an operational Control Tower dashboard.

## Principles: What He Stands For

- **Ship fast**: Target one product, skill, or experiment every one to two weeks.
- **AI with human judgment**: Use AI aggressively as a build tool while inspecting, testing, and owning every line and decision.
- **Influence without a title**: Persuasion, clarity, and practical communication matter more than org-chart rank.
- **Contrarian and free of hype**: Take clear positions backed by operational data or firsthand experience.
- **Frameworks and first principles**: Clarify the mental model first, then execute decisively.
- **Investing discipline**: Margin of safety, business quality, and long-term capital allocation.
